newsitem.title: VATICAN: Pope sends condolences for Venezuela earthquake.
newsitem.headline: Pope sends condolences for Venezuela earthquake.

text.p: Pope Jean Paul sent his condolences on Friday to the survivors of an earthquake in eastern Venezuela that killed at least 68 people and injured hundreds more.

"The Holy Father Pope John Paul II offers his condolences for the eternal rest of those killed and prays fervently that the Lord may grant his comfort to those affected by this awful incident," a telegram from the Vatican read.
At least 469 people were injured and some 500 families were left homeless by Thursday's quake, which officials said was Venezuela's worst in three decades.
